name: awesome-black-friday (bergside)
accepts: 'Deals on dev tools, AI, and more' for developers and designers, in sections Hosting, Security, AI, Email, Social, Learning, Analytics, Marketing, Development & design, Productivity. No Mac or iOS section. Some of its links are affiliate links, per the README.
how_to_submit: Open an issue, or send a pull request 'with the offer, dates, and an official source'. No template.
entry_format: A bullet per deal, not a table: a favicon image from assets/, the bold linked name, a one-line description, then a details block with the offer, the code and a link to the official offer page. Alphabetical within each section.
rules: Keep descriptions short and disclose any affiliate links.
